segments.headline: LOS PERROS DEL MAL
segments.subhead: def. La Parka, Mr. Iguana & Niño Hamburguesa
segments.detail: Daga, Angel and Berto retained their titles after Daga pinned La Parka.
segments.ticker: LOS PERROS DEL MAL RETAIN THE AAA WORLD TRIOS TITLES

segments.headline: LA CATALINA
segments.detail: La Catalina pinned Flammer after a running knee to retain the Reina de Reinas title.
segments.ticker: LA CATALINA RETAINS THE REINA DE REINAS CHAMPIONSHIP

segments.headline: EL GRANDE AMERICANO
segments.detail: Despite ringside interference, Americano prevailed with a running headbutt.
segments.ticker: EL GRANDE AMERICANO DEFEATS DOMINIK MYSTERIO

segments.headline: BIG MAMI RETURNS
segments.subhead: Returns after the trios title match
segments.detail: Big Mami charged in after Los Perros del Mal attacked their opponents, confronting Karmen Petrovic.
segments.ticker: BIG MAMI RETURNS TO CONFRONT KARMEN PETROVIC

segments.headline: REY MYSTERIO
segments.subhead: Stops interference in the title match
segments.detail: Rey Mysterio confronted Omos and struck Dominik with a chair during Americano’s title defense.
segments.ticker: REY MYSTERIO INTERVENES AS AMERICANO RETAINS

segments.headline: FLAMMER / LA HIEDRA
segments.detail: Flammer and La Hiedra repeatedly argued during their failed title challenge.
segments.ticker: FLAMMER AND LA HIEDRA CLASH DURING TRIPLE THREAT

segments.headline: REY FÉNIX
segments.detail: After Mini Vikingo was sidelined by an elbow injury, Fénix faced an open challenge for Week 2.
segments.ticker: REY FÉNIX CRUISERWEIGHT OPEN CHALLENGE SET FOR OCT 31
